description: Arithmetic underflow or panic permanently blocks liquidation of qualifying positions

poc_level_descriptors.L3A: public execute_liquidation entrypoint called (not just calculate_liquidation)
poc_level_descriptors.L3B: execute_liquidation panics/reverts for a qualifying deeply insolvent position
poc_level_descriptors.L3C: N/A — for DoS findings, L3B is the maximum provable impact without live chain

high_severity_rationale: For DoS of a core safety mechanism (liquidation), L3B through the public entrypoint is sufficient for High. The harm is the blocked liquidation itself — no attacker profit assertion is required because the loss is accumulated bad debt.
negative_control_template: Run the same test replacing the plain subtraction with saturating_sub. Assert the call succeeds and returns a valid LiquidationCall (collateral_amount = total_collateral_base, no panic).
